title: Core Calculator UI and Form Submission
user_story: As a user, I want a plain HTML UI served at the root route / with two number inputs, an operation picker for add/subtract/multiply/divide, and a Calculate button, so that I can prepare my calculation request.
acceptance_criteria: The page loads at the root route / with a plain HTML UI.
Two number inputs are present on the page.
A way to pick one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) is available.
A Calculate button submits the form.
